reasons: Amber: CCC credit spread (OAS), AI basket drawdown / momentum, Breadth (RSP/SPY, % above 50dma)
Regime: credit-led — Credit is involved — more serious than an equity-only dip.
Hedge pricing (not in composite): Put skew / cost of tail insurance moderate, Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV) cheap

indicators.label: HY credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Level 2.69% (amber ≥4.5%), 5d change -1bp (amber ≥+30bp). A fast widening is the best short-lead credit signal.

indicators.label: CCC credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Junkiest credit tier — closest public proxy for the leveraged AI periphery.

indicators.label: HYG/IEF ratio (credit vs safety)
indicators.detail: High-yield ETF vs Treasuries — a same-day credit read with no FRED lag.

indicators.label: Leveraged loans (BKLN)
indicators.detail: Floating-rate senior secured loans — isolates credit risk from rate moves. Tracking HY closely (-0.6pp 10d).

indicators.label: SOFR − IORB (funding stress)
indicators.detail: Repo rate over the interest-on-reserves floor; a persistent positive spread means funding stress.

indicators.label: Funding tail (SOFR spread + Fed repo use)
indicators.detail: SOFR 99th−1st percentile 14bp (amber ≥30bp); Fed repo ops $0.0bn (3d max) (amber ≥$5bn). Needs both legs to confirm stress over calendar effects.

indicators.label: Chicago Fed NFCI
indicators.detail: Weekly financial-conditions composite; positive = tighter than average.

indicators.label: VIX term structure (VIX/VIX3M)
indicators.detail: ≥1.00 = backwardation — the near-coincident confirmation signal (days of lead at most).

indicators.label: Put skew / cost of tail insurance
indicators.detail: SKEW 143 (expensive ≥145), VVIX 86 (expensive ≥110). Tail insurance is moderately priced. Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV)
indicators.detail: VIX 15.7 sits at the 19th percentile of its trailing year (expensive ≥80th); 20d realized 13.3, so implied carries +2.4 vol points of premium (expensive ≥8). Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Periphery canaries (CRWV, ORCL)
indicators.detail: Sharp equity drops or realized-vol spikes in the debt-financed periphery stand in for CDS.

indicators.label: Breadth (RSP/SPY, % above 50dma)
indicators.detail: Narrowing breadth = fragility backdrop; slow signal, low weight.

indicators.label: Yield curve (10y−3m)
indicators.detail: Inversion is a 6–18 month gauge, not a timing signal — capped at amber.

items.headline: Nebius upsizes convertible notes to $5.75B, beating raised target, against ~$1.4B revenue base
items.note: Neocloud operator closed $5.75B in 2030/2034 convertible notes (above an already-raised $5B target) to fund GPU buildout, layering large debt onto a thin revenue base — a leverage-buildup signal worth tracking, not a stress event since the deal was oversubscribed.

items.headline: Broadcom credit-default swaps widen 28bps in August as it backstops AI chip-financing SPVs
items.note: Broadcom's 5-yr CDS rose 28bps and bond yields +14bps this month — a bigger move than Oracle or SpaceX — as it plans $60B+ of new AI debt financing and off-balance-sheet guarantees, feeding 'phantom leverage' concerns across chip-financing SPVs.

items.headline: Neocloud Lambda in talks for $3B pre-IPO round, months after $917M loan against its own GPUs
items.note: Lambda is raising pre-IPO equity partly to dilute a balance sheet already carrying GPU-collateralized debt used to buy more Nvidia chips — the kind of depreciating-collateral loan structure credit watchers flag as fragile, though this raise itself is a de-risking move, not a stress event.

disclaimer: Not financial advice. No indicator reliably times crashes; this composite raises the odds of a short heads-up, nothing more.
